prompt:
A distribution center manages one SKU with the following annual demand and cost parameters:

Annual demand: 12000 units
Ordering cost: $200 per order
Holding cost: $6.24 per unit per year
Average daily demand standard deviation: 11.75 units (assume 250 working days per year)
Supplier lead time: 10 days
Target cycle-service level: 99% (z = 2.33)

Using standard continuous-review (Q, R) inventory-policy formulas:
EOQ = sqrt(2 x Annual Demand x Ordering Cost / Holding Cost)
Average Daily Demand = Annual Demand / Working Days Per Year
Safety Stock = z x Daily Demand Standard Deviation x sqrt(Lead Time in days)
Reorder Point = (Average Daily Demand x Lead Time in days) + Safety Stock

Compute: (1) the Economic Order Quantity, (2) the Safety Stock, and (3) the Reorder Point, each rounded to 2 decimal places.

Report 3 numbers in this order: EOQ, Safety Stock, Reorder Point.
